items.title: Virginia Mayhew interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 23, 2022
items.q: But the better, the older and better I get I realize like Monk said, there aren’t really any wrong notes

ctx.x: Well it begs the question, and I often times ask this one, the question is are there wrong notes in improvising for you?

I think it’s a matter of the music that you’re playing and your intent. Because you can hit, I mean if you’re playing something that’s really inside, to me it sounds sort of weird unless you were playing like maybe you’re playing some sort of idea that you’re in and then you take it out and then you come back in. But if you just play one note that’s really sticking out there and then you don’t — like I don’t know if you’ve ever done this, you play something — oh I’m not sure about that. And then instead of just…
I agree. You usually can sort of tell if people are doing it on purpose rather than they don’t know that it’s sort of not working.
